units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 6:1:3">Y. Peah VI, beg. 19ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:11">Ex. XXIII, 11</cite>) <he>יש לך נ׳ אחרת כזו</he> there is another resignation like this (<cite ref="E00759"><he>הֶפְקֵר</he></cite>).
Ib. נ׳ מיעוט וכ׳ the superfluous ונטשתה (Ex. l. c.) intimates a limitation: this you must resign indiscriminately for the benefit of the poor or of the rich, but &c.
